slides.title: Static Analysis with Mypy and Pyright
slides.prompt: Static analysis tools like `mypy` and `pyright` analyze Python source code without executing it, catching type mismatch errors, missing attributes, and unhandled optional values before runtime.
slides.codeSnippet:
# Run mypy from command line:
# mypy script.py --strict

# mypy.ini configuration example:
# [mypy]
# disallow_untyped_defs = True
# warn_return_any = True
